'''2001 Utah State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Weber State College, Utah in April 2001. [[Nathan Magro]] won it. It is known from Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2064">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-smeg-runnin-states-like-butter-ut-04-01d2064/ smeg-runnin-states-like-butter-ut-04-01], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 13 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-smeg-runnin-states-like-butter-ut-04-01d2064/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2001
* '''Site:''' Weber State College, Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 26
* '''Winner:''' [[Nathan Magro]]
